gates.name: point-in-time packet integrity
gates.requirement: technical, fundamentals, historical sentiment, and macro must be 100% covered

gates.name: point-in-time metadata
gates.requirement: use versioned historical metadata or omit unversioned company attributes

gates.name: historical news source
gates.observed: not_configured; SEC filing events are not a complete provider news feed
gates.requirement: provider-versioned historical news coverage, with publication and first-available clocks

gates.name: historical macro source
gates.observed: dated replay source(s): FRED:DFF; single-rate observation only
gates.requirement: macro observations must carry observation and first-available dates

gates.name: production provider run
gates.observed: provider_run.json missing; current manifest is in-session
gates.requirement: authenticated provider invocation bound to exact predictions and score

gates.name: survivorship-safe universe
gates.observed: universe.json missing; current fixed ticker list is not enough
gates.requirement: hashed source extract and point-in-time membership for every trial

gates.name: scored terminal-return provenance
gates.requirement: scored returns must be tied to the declared total-return data hash

gates.name: execution cost calibration
gates.observed: cost_model.json missing; bps is only an assumption
gates.requirement: externally calibrated spread, slippage, commission, and benchmark parity

gates.name: scored panel completeness
gates.requirement: one complete scored outcome per frozen (ticker, as-of) trial

gates.name: effective sample
gates.observed: invalid or missing overall portfolio effective_n=None

gates.name: strict long-hold benchmark
gates.requirement: same window, universe, timing, and costs; pipeline must beat strict hold

gates.name: paired strict-hold alpha interval
gates.requirement: lower 95% time-block-bootstrap bound of paired log excess must be > 0
